Don-Jo 5" x 26" 5 x 26 Black Kick Plate

5 inch wide x 26 inch high kick plate. Made of .050" thick high quality black powder coated solid stainless steel for longevity. Packaged with color matched mounting screws for easy installation.

These commercial push plates are made in the USA by Don-Jo Mfg.

Specifications of the Don-Jo KP-6x20-630 Black Push Plate:

  • Finish: Black Powder Coat
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Plate Width: 5"
  • Plate Height: 26"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Color Matched Mounting Screws

Sold Individually
